name: asimov-solo
_note: Asimov 1 alone on a 12.8 m patrol — the rig for watching THIS robot walk, with nothing else in the room to explain a stall away. The companion level asimov-walkabout adds three following ducks, and they change the problem: they crowd its feet, it yields, and a yielded command can fall under the policy's floor (see robots/asimov_walk.MIN_FORWARD_CMD). Solo there is no yielding at all (yield_m 0), so a stall here is the ROBOT. MEASURED over 90 s, no falls and zero waiting at every speed: 0.20 -> 15.0 m (1 lap), 0.25 -> 20.3 m, 0.35 -> 28.7 m (2 laps), 0.50 -> 38.4 m (3 laps). 0.35 is the default because it laps twice while sitting well clear of the 0.20 deadband; drop to 0.25 if you want a more sensitive probe of the gait's floor.
